Clean Fixture Site

Clean Fixture Site is a deliberately correct static build, published at https://clean.example.com/, used by the siteseo test suite.

This build exists so the test suite can prove a correct site produces no error-severity findings. Every page here has a unique title, a unique description, one h1, a self-referencing canonical, and images that declare their dimensions.
